correctness.rationale: In every S(3,4,v), completion of each triple is unique. For each nonblock four-set its four triple completions are distinct and outside, leaving v-8 generic points. Exactly the same fifth-step atomic extension types occur for all v≥10, proving five-round equivalence; all v≥8 match through four moves. The existential five-variable sentence separates v=8 from v≥10, and existing systems of orders 8 and 10 give sharp bound 10. The embedded independent recursive FO signature checker matches the proof on concrete orders 8,10,16; infinite proof is mathematical, not extrapolation.

value.rationale: Natural complete classification of all finite nontrivial S(3,4,v) in their canonical point-only block language. The 4-to-5 rank threshold isolates the first ability to see an unforced point beyond a four-set’s four triple completions, producing two classes and a sharp 10-point representative bound despite more than one million SQS(16) isomorphism types. This is a structural finite-model-theoretic phenomenon with a natural exact invariant, not a random finite tally.
